summary: Top-level package API re-exporting all user-facing symbols: expression entry points (col, lit, when, coalesce, today, now, etc.), relation constructors (relation, concat), TypeSpec/DataPackage types, RelationDAG/ResourceRef, and convenience factories (typespec(), datacontract()). Single import entry point via 'import mountainash as ma'.

key_functions.name: typespec(columns, **metadata)
key_functions.purpose: Convenience factory creating TypeSpec from simple {name: type_string} dict

key_functions.name: datacontract(source)
key_functions.purpose: Universal factory creating BaseDataContract from TypeSpec, dict, Pydantic, pandera, Frictionless, or simple dict

extension_points: datacontract() factory accepts multiple source types
lifecycle_notes: today() and now() added to re-exports 2026-05
datacontract() has lazy imports to avoid hard pandera/pydantic dependency
No __all__ defined — all re-exports are implicit
documentation_hooks: Primary API surface — every user tutorial starts here
risks: No explicit __all__ may affect IDE completions
